components.name: DeepStreamManagerCard
components.description: Comprehensive DeepStream management: sidecar status, GPU/throughput stats, stream grid with live thumbnails, and a floating per-stream detail drawer with real-time inference playback (WebRTC/WHEP) and snapshot fallback.

title.title: Card Title
title.description: Optional override of the card title.

serverHost.title: DeepStream Server Address
serverHost.description: IP or hostname where the DeepStream sidecar + mediamtx run (e.g. the Jetson). Leave empty to use the extension-level 'DeepStream Server Address' (recommended — set once in extension config), and fall back to the current page hostname if that is also empty.

webrtcPort.title: WebRTC Port
webrtcPort.description: mediamtx WebRTC port (unused — HLS is used for playback).

hlsPort.title: HLS Port
hlsPort.description: mediamtx HLS port for detail video playback, default 8888.

mjpegPort.title: MJPEG Preview Port
mjpegPort.description: MJPEG streaming server port for live thumbnail previews, default 8090.

snapshotToken.title: Snapshot Auth Token
snapshotToken.description: Required for live thumbnail polling + snapshot fallback. Leave empty to show placeholders only.

defaultStreamId.title: Default Stream
defaultStreamId.description: Optional stream id to auto-select in the detail drawer when the card opens (once that stream is present).
